integrity: All proofs refer to the explicit algebra and standard Lucas congruences. Finite parameter checks supplement but do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the displayed dimension intervals are covered; the dimension of an arbitrary abelian subalgebra is not determined. An unindexed older modular adaptation remains a residual priority risk.
title: Prime-characteristic plateaux for abelian ideals in truncated Zinbiel algebras
